title: At Disconnect the source turns local before the phone's record is drawn, so a render in between can count the cloud's epoch under the phone's name
evidence: From the S72 work. ios/HealthRoadmap/Sync/CloudSync.swift:253-254 queues store.showPhone() then sends .disconnectEnded, so sync.provider is nil and RootView's source (App/RootView.swift:189) is "" while showPhone still waits on the engine's loadPhone (MyData/RecordStore.swift showPhone). The store is still .cloud, then .leaving, and still draws the cloud's record. The source change fires onChange(of: shownRecord) (RootView.swift:121), recordChanged runs, and Cover.countable("", …) (App/FirstRun.swift Cover.countable) is true, so takeCount (RootView.swift:217-220) can store the cloud record's eraseEpoch under "". After the copy-down the epochs are almost always equal, so no false erase was found. Design note first; touches the store's source. Suggested fix: the local case also requires the store on .phone (store.source.erase == nil). Test: Disconnect, a render between .disconnectEnded and the phone's draw, no count taken until the phone's record lands.
